goal: Validate local-lazy knowledge growth, update, invalidation, internalization, and maintenance cost without adding a second knowledge authority.
acceptance_criteria: raw evidence remains byte-faithful and provenance-bound while derived abstractions remain recomputable
all required update relations and lifecycle stages produce deterministic auditable receipts
exact duplicate ingestion performs zero model calls and no derived rebuild
leaf updates invalidate only actual dependent abstractions and Conversation excludes stale derived evidence
flat, eager-global, and local-lazy policies are compared at 100, 1000, and 5000 entries
full repository regression has zero failures and zero errors

quality_metrics.measure: required ingestion, relation, invalidation, refresh, and Conversation-after-update behaviors
quality_metrics.method: deterministic unit, schema, application-boundary, and integration tests

quality_metrics.measure: unrelated nodes touched and derived nodes recomputed per local update
quality_metrics.target: zero unrelated nodes and no hot-path derived recomputation

quality_metrics.measure: write latency, retrieval candidates, context characters, model calls, and persisted pack size
quality_metrics.target: local semantic maintenance remains bounded and exact duplicates use zero model calls
quality_metrics.method: fixed deterministic Flat Append, Eager Global Rebuild, and Local Lazy benchmark
kernel profiles, collection, application suite, and full pytest

prevention: raw evidence cannot be replaced by summaries
control: strict evidence identity and relation target validation
improvement: replace compatibility bucket scans with indexed changed-node updates

interface_expectations: knowledge.internalize@1.0 uses the common Component/Block boundary
ProjectKnowledgePack remains the only knowledge and evidence identity authority
Conversation request and response semantics remain unchanged

feedback: ProjectKnowledgePack remains the only knowledge authority and existing Conversation retrieval remains the only retrieval authority.
Local-lazy invalidation is bounded by actual dependencies and performs no hot-path recomputation or model calls.
The benefit claim is directional; full-pack serialization remains linear and is explicitly retained as a P2 risk.

worked: separating exact raw identity from semantic similarity
using explicit dependency edges and stale-derived exclusion
freezing source before 100/1000/5000 evidence and full regression
did_not_work: the first unit profile ran before the application receipt was refreshed and correctly failed freshness
experiments: Flat Append versus Eager Global Rebuild versus Local Lazy at 100, 1000, and 5000 entries
Conversation query after superseding evidence and stale-summary invalidation
